location_text: Multiple points around Papua New Guinea (2200 local 24 Jan 1985)

shape_raw: Bright light of enormous intensity with bow-wave-like trail (shape indiscernible at night); resembled high-speed photo of bullet in flight
witness_role: civilian airline aircrew (Tajik Air B747SP — chief pilot and two colleagues, all American)
media_captured: Olympus pocket camera photos (per pilot, copies pending)
summary: Three American Tajik Air pilots flying a B747SP at FL410 over Kazakhstan watched a brilliant high-altitude object maneuver in circles, corkscrews and 90-degree high-G turns for ~40 minutes before adopting a horizontal high-speed course and disappearing over the horizon. Aircraft later flew under the object's contrails (estimated ~100,000 ft) whose paths matched the observed maneuvers. Captain photographed object with a pocket Olympus camera; crew rejected meteor hypothesis based on prior PanAm experience.
outcome: Object adopted horizontal high-speed course and disappeared over the horizon

Object held constant size and light intensity for 5-10 seconds, moved east-to-west parallel to ground with no wings/exhaust, then the light extinguished and the object vanished from a clear sky. No vehicular EMI noted; witness experienced post-event sleep disturbance.
weather: Clear, good visibility, sun rising in east
outcome: Object vanished after light extinguished; could not be relocated

summary: Two agents observed a glowing orange orb near a rock pinnacle; estimated 500-600 m range (AARO post-measurement: ~1050 m and 12-18 m diameter). Object hovered/suspended with zero resistance for about a minute. No noticeable sound.

shape_raw: ill-defined dark kite shape with rounded sides; thin line from rear; later described to AARO as triangular; lights at ~2-3 ft off the ground (one red, one white) initially mistaken for a car
witness_role: federal law enforcement special agents (USPER5, USPER6)
summary: Two agents pursued what appeared to be a car on a road in a restricted zone. Object suddenly moved laterally off-road across desert at ~15-20 mph without altering orientation or altitude, with 'zero resistance'. Stopped 100 m off road, lights off, leaving a thin horizontal line in NVGs (~4 ft wide). Later described to AARO as triangular.

location_text: Western U.S., within a few hundred meters of the 'Dark Kite' sighting
shape_raw: kite-shaped object canted from lower right to upper left; lighting pattern similar to Dark Kite; appeared partially transparent (stars visible through it in NVG); ~6 m off the ground, drifting with the wind
witness_role: federal law enforcement special agents (USPER5, USPER6); USPER7 present but did not see object
summary: Approximately 30 minutes after the Dark Kite event and within a few hundred meters of the same area, USPER5 (NVG) and USPER6 (bare eye) observed a kite-shaped object ~6 m above ground, canted lower-right to upper-left, drifting slowly with the wind. Through NVG the object appeared partially transparent (stars visible through it). After visual loss, a spotlight beam appeared to be blocked at a localized spot in mid-air, then unblocked when redirected. USPER7 did not see the object.
